key_points: LVS hit a new 1-year low, signaling sustained technical weakness and bearish momentum.
Bank of America established a ~$40.4M position, suggesting institutional accumulation at depressed levels — a contrarian positive.
Corient Private Wealth sold shares, adding to near-term institutional selling pressure.
Mixed analyst sentiment and modest daily losses indicate no strong directional conviction among market participants.
Overall these are largely routine institutional flows and price action — not thesis-changing fundamentals — so impact is low.
